title: AI Engineering & Generative AI
tagline: Foundations, LLMs, Neural Networks & Production Systems
description: Master Artificial Intelligence, machine learning principles, deep learning, LLMs, RAG architectures, autonomous agents, and production AI engineering from mathematical and programming foundations to scalable enterprise systems.

title: Operating Systems Masterclass
description: Master operating systems engineering from computer architecture, systems programming in C, kernel execution, virtual memory, filesystems, and crash consistency to advanced multiprocessor synchronization.

title: Computer Networks Masterclass
tagline: Internet Protocols, Packet Analysis & Distributed Infrastructure
description: Master computer networks from OSI & TCP/IP models, physical transmission, IPv4/IPv6, routing protocols, and transport mechanics (TCP/UDP/QUIC) to network security, Wireshark packet analysis, and cloud network architecture.

title: Cybersecurity Masterclass
description: Master information security, adversarial threat modeling, secure system design, ethical vulnerability assessment, OWASP Top 10, NIST CSF 2.0, MITRE ATT&CK, and practical defense based on MIT, Stanford, CMU, and UC Berkeley curricula.

title: System Design Masterclass
tagline: Architecture, Scalability & Resilience at Production Scale
description: Master large-scale distributed systems, architectural thinking, capacity planning, monoliths vs microservices, high availability, fault tolerance, and trade-off analysis from foundational principles to production-grade engineering.

title: Cloud Computing Track
description: Master cloud architecture, core compute models, virtual networking, managed storage, databases, multi-cloud strategy, cloud security posture, FinOps economics, and disaster-resilient cloud engineering.

title: DevOps & SRE Track
description: Learn production-grade DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering through Linux, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, GitOps, cloud-native infrastructure, observability, and incident response.

title: Blockchain Technology & Decentralized Systems
tagline: Cryptography, Distributed Ledgers, Consensus & Smart Contracts
description: Master blockchain engineering, distributed ledgers, cryptographic primitives, SHA-256 linking, peer-to-peer network consensus, smart contracts, and decentralized application architecture based on Stanford, MIT, and UC Berkeley curricula.

title: Data Engineering Master Course
tagline: Pipelines, Distributed Systems, Lakehouses & Modern Data Systems
description: Master data engineering principles, pipeline architecture, OLTP vs OLAP, batch and stream processing, ETL/ELT workflows, data warehouses, data lakes, modern lakehouses (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake), data quality, and end-to-end data systems.
